meta_title: George The Plumber | Emergency Plumber Coventry
meta_description: George The Plumber in Coventry offers emergency plumbing, repairs, and installations. Fast response times, honest pricing. Call 07415 433498 for help now.
hero_subhead: Burst pipe or boiler breakdown in Coventry? We arrive within the hour, any time of day or night.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing Repairs
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaks, and blockages fixed fast. We carry common parts on the van and aim to resolve most jobs in a single visit.

services.title: Boiler Repair & Servicing
services.desc: Annual servicing keeps your boiler safe and efficient. Breakdown repairs available 24/7 — no extended downtime.

services.title: Central Heating Installation
services.desc: New heating systems installed to Building Regulations. We advise on efficiency upgrades to reduce your bills.

services.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Plumbing
services.desc: Full installation of new bathrooms and kitchens, including pipework, taps, and drainage. All work guaranteed.

services.title: Drain Unblocking & Cleaning
services.desc: Stubborn blockages cleared using professional equipment. We also offer preventive drain surveys for peace of mind.

services.title: Radiator Installation & Repair
services.desc: Replace old radiators or add new ones to improve warmth and control. Fast turnaround with minimal disruption.

about_pullquote: I started this business to do plumbing right — no hidden charges, no jargon, just honest work.
about_para_1: George The Plumber has served Coventry homes and businesses for over 15 years. We began as a one-man operation and have grown steadily by fixing problems properly the first time and treating every customer fairly. Our reputation is built on turning up on time, diagnosing faults clearly, and charging what the job is actually worth.
about_para_2: Customers call us back because we answer the phone, we listen, and we get the job done without the drama. Whether it's a midnight burst pipe or a planned boiler installation, we bring the same professionalism and care to every callout. Many of our jobs now come from word-of-mouth — that's the best compliment we can receive.

reviews.text: New boiler installation took a day. George explained everything clearly, the price was fair, and he left the place spotless. Five stars.
